cuts.desc: Extreme close on Davi's face, eyes narrow; chalk-blue math (v = 1.674 x cos φ) sketches around him; fast push-in, impact zoom on 'conta'
Wide: stylised globe spinning, ground-speed arrows streaming east along the surface; whip-in
Globe tilts; two HUD chips pop: 1 LATITUDE (↕) and 2 LONGITUDE (↔); push-in
Equator line ignites around the globe; push-in toward the equator
Whip-rotation of the globe; Rio's meridian (43° W) lights up pole to pole
Detail: red pin drops on Rio, impact zoom + shake
Angle arc sweeps from the equator down to Rio: HUD 23° S
Mirror: arc sweeps up the same meridian to 23° N, blue pin pops; tilt up
Camera tracks along the meridian from Rio to 23° N, pulse travels the line
Two identical east arrows on both points, HUD 1.540 km/h each + 23° S = 23° N
Crash zoom into the 23° N point: middle of the Atlantic, nothing but water
Split screen wipe: Copacabana sea vs mid-Atlantic sea, identical horizons (RIO | 23° N)
Close: Davi looks at the sea, half smile; slow push + tilt
Kiosk: Rocha gripping Davi's wrist -> both vanish: Rastro, flash, shockwave, heavy shake
Open ocean: Rastro tear in mid-air, both drop into the water, big splash
Close at water level: the two heads bobbing, parados, glove still on the yellow wrist
Drone pull-back straight up: two dots in an endless ocean, HUD TERRA 1.900 km
Detail: black glove lets go of the yellow sleeve over the water
Rocha splashes to swim; Davi blinks out with a Rastro
Kiosk: Rastro, Davi pops back in, açaí in hand, takes a spoonful
Ocean: orange ring buoy falls from the sky, plops next to Rocha
Detail: phone in Davi's hand calling MARINHA, ringing pulses
High angle: three suits run up to the kiosk, look around, nobody there
Close: Rocha in the water wearing the buoy, sunglasses crooked, furious
Medium: Davi at the kiosk tossing a red can, smirk
Final close: can spinning above his hand, Rastro zaps around it, flash
Hard cut to black
